page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-tee.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance built on KVM virtualization and x86_64 architecture. Processing is handled by 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8469C processor running at a base frequency of 2.6 GHz. System memory totals 96.0 GB, establishing a balanced resource ratio of 6.0 GB of RAM per dedicated vCPU core.

Hardware acceleration is supplied via a single discrete GPU providing 96 GB of VRAM, accommodating memory-demanding parallel execution models. Network connectivity features a 12 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The platform includes no integrated local storage, requiring attached network volumes for persistent storage, and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The instance design focuses on accelerator memory capacity rather than integrated disk I/O, delivering qualitative cost efficiency for organizations requiring significant GPU frame buffers without paying for bundled high-speed local NVMe drives. Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-tee.4xlarge is suited for machine learning inference, model evaluation, visual computing, and memory-intensive scientific simulations.
